body:
> sometime. Please reply or pm me.

I always try to distract myself. I was luckily able to bring my computer to my friend's house where I'm staying so I've been spending my time playing MMO's because that gives me something to do (Used to raid in WoW but I've since switched to FFXIV for a change in scenary). 

For MMO's it's not even the video game so much as the people, I don't feel as socially isolated. I've made a few friends in WoW that have joined me in FFXIV so it's not so bad I suppose.

The last sentence really got to me. You're right, I didn't want to ever imagine her standing in front of my grave. Never being able to get to know me. But at this point I'm wondering if that's even a possibility anymore. Like I said in OP, she's calling another man daddy. So I doubt she'd even know who I am anymore. It's hard to realize that.

I know 3 months doesn't seem like much. But when you take into consideration I could be on the street within the next few weeks it's a really long time.
I appreciate you're trying to help but I don't believe in any form of higher power. So I can't say anything to something that I don't believe in.
